description: AI Agents: Use when someone wants an AI agent in one of their systems and has said what it should do, such as "read my deals and add follow-up tasks". Returns what it would read or change and a link that opens the setup filled in. Each plan is saved as a new concept: nothing works until the person finishes it in CRM Connector. Not for syncing two systems (use plan_integration).

action_groups.description: Optional groups of actions to switch on, as get_ai_agent_options names them.

change_record_types.description: Optional record types it may also change.

read_record_types.description: Optional record types it may only read.

system.description: The system the agent works in. Its name or key, such as hubspot.

name: plan_ai_agent
title: Plan an AI agent
